remarks:
Exceptional opportunity to own a spacious all-brick 3-unit property in the heart of Niagara Falls, just steps from Pine Avenue’s shops, restaurants, and neighborhood conveniences. Offering over 2,300 square feet of living space, this versatile property is ideal for investors seeking strong rental potential or owner-occupants looking to offset expenses with additional income.

The building features three separate apartments, including a 1-bedroom unit, a 2-bedroom unit, and a spacious 3-bedroom unit. Many rooms offer high ceilings, large windows, and abundant natural light, while several units showcase updated kitchens, updated baths, and attractive hardwood or laminate flooring.

Recent improvements include a newer roof and some newer windows, providing added value and peace of mind. Separate gas and electric service, individual heating systems, and separate hot water tanks offer efficient operation and simplified property management.

Additional highlights include off-street parking, a garage, covered porch space, full basement with laundry hookups, and low-maintenance brick construction. Conveniently located near schools, parks, public transportation, downtown Niagara Falls, the Niagara Gorge, and world-famous attractions.

Whether you’re expanding your investment portfolio, looking for a house-hack opportunity, or seeking a multi-family property with excellent upside potential, 639 18th Street offers flexibility, character, and value in a rapidly developing Niagara Falls location.
